scope: CI provisions Chrome (runner google-chrome) with SwiftShader WebGPU and Playwright 1.62.1, and runs every *-browser.test.mjs in packages/barocss-gpu (25 files) and packages/barocss-viewer (3 files) when either package is affected or the plan is full. A run passes only with fail/cancelled/skipped/todo 0, pass == tests > 0 and no file without a test; a missing CHROME/PW_DIR fails in CI and is NOT_RUN locally.
dependencies: No package or lockfile change. Playwright 1.62.1 (the local PW_DIR version, checked on npm) is installed by the CI action into $RUNNER_TEMP with --ignore-scripts and no browser download.
